_: POINT-IN-TIME macro vintages for Egypt: what was KNOWN at each year-end, for the valuation calibration [R-VCAL-01] to rebuild a fair value at that origin. NOT the forward path in engine/macro_paths/EG.json, which is what the house believes today. A rebuild that reaches for today's numbers is not a rebuild; it is the answer wearing a date.
target_span: 2013-2023 year-ends, the span the pre-registration of 03-Sep-2026 fixes
rule: A VINTAGE IS SOURCED OR IT DOES NOT EXIST. Four fields on every figure — value, source, date, tier. No interpolation between years, no carrying a neighbouring year forward, no 'approximately'. An origin whose figures are not all sourced is DROPPED by the calibration and its window shortened, which the pre-registration fixes in advance precisely so that a thin archive shows up as fewer origins rather than as a fuller-looking record built on filled-in cells.
status: ASSEMBLY IN PROGRESS. The equity risk premium and the sovereign default spread are sourced for every origin 2013-2023 from the Damodaran archived vintages — the premium PUBLISHED at each origin, not today's reading of that year. Still to source, one origin at a time: sovereign_10y, cpi_annual and policy_rate. No origin is USABLE until all four are present, and engine/macro_history.py report() is the only place to read which are. Never this note.

sources_used.erp_and_default_spread: Damodaran, NYU Stern, 'Risk Premiums for Other Markets', archived by year at pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar/pc/archives/. The filename convention ctryprem{YY} = the vintage published 1 January {YY+1} is CONFIRMED by each file's own 'Updated' line, not assumed: 2013->Jan 2014 through 2024->Jan 2025, with one exception recorded below.
sources_used.vintage_exception: ctryprem15.xls carries 'Updated July 1, 2016' — a mid-year re-publication rather than the usual 1 January. Recorded as it stands.
sources_used.stale_cell_trap: ctryprem19.xls and ctryprem20.xls each carry a STALE 'Date of update' cell (2015-12-31 and 2016-12-31) beside a correct 'Updated January 1, 2020/2021' line. A first extraction pass read the stale cell and would have misdated two vintages by four years. Both stamps are recorded per origin and the conflict is stated in the source string.
